name: Reading and interpreting graphs
subject: Mathematical Literacy
example_problem: From a line graph of two electricity tariff options, read the break-even usage, state which option is cheaper for 450 kWh, and describe what the steeper gradient means in rands per kWh.

importance.summary: Tariff-comparison and break-even questions in Finance (Q2, Paper 1) and the integration questions (Q4-5 on both papers) are asked through graphs.
